title: ACIM Feed Forward Control
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Controls/Control Reference/ACIM_Feed_Forward_Control.md
text: Decouple d -axis and q -axis current to eliminate disturbance, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Number of pole pairs}, {Motor parameter input method} sets the type of motor parameters Linear model with lumped, {Stator leakage inductance (H)} sets the leakage inductance of stator winding, {Rotor leakage inductance (H)} sets the leakage inductance of rotor winding, {Magnetizing Inductance (H)} sets the magnetizing inductance of induction motor, {Rated Flux (Wb)} sets the rated flux, {D-axis current breakpoint vector, id (A)} sets the d -axis current lookup, {Q-axis current breakpoint vector, id (A)} sets the q -axis current lookup, {D-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD (id,iq) (Wb)} sets the reference d -axis flux linkage lookup data 4.4e-2 *, {Q-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD (id,iq) (Wb)} sets the reference q -axis flux linkage lookup data 2.1e-3 *, {Output Saturation (V)} sets the saturation limit for output values 24/sqrt, {Input units} sets the unit of input values Per-Unit, {Base Voltage (V)} sets the base voltage for per-unit system 24/sqrt, {Base Current (A)} sets the base current for per-unit system and {Base Speed (rpm)} sets the base speed for per-unit system. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Motor parameter input method
params.values: Type of motor parameters Linear model with lumped parameters (default) | Non-linear model with D,Q-flux linkage LUTs

params.name: Stator leakage inductance (H)
params.values: Leakage inductance of stator winding 6.81e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Rotor leakage inductance (H)
params.values: Leakage inductance of rotor winding 6.81e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Magnetizing Inductance (H)
params.values: Magnetizing inductance of induction motor 30e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: D-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD (id,iq) (Wb)
params.values: Reference d -axis flux linkage lookup data 4.4e-2 * repmat([0, 150, 350, 500]’, 1, 3) (default) | vector

params.name: Q-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD (id,iq) (Wb)
params.values: Reference q -axis flux linkage lookup data 2.1e-3 * repmat([0, 250, 500], 4, 1) (default) | vector

params.name: Output Saturation (V)
params.values: Saturation limit for output values 24/sqrt(3) (default) | scalar

params.name: Input units
params.values: Unit of input values Per-Unit (PU) (default) | SI Units

params.name: Base Voltage (V)
params.values: Base voltage for per-unit system 24/sqrt(3) (default) | scalar

params.name: Base Current (A)
params.values: Base current for per-unit system 5.3611 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base Speed (rpm)
params.values: Base speed for per-unit system 1500 (default) | scalar
